column1: # Every package a complete release must contain, and its class.
# The publish job refuses to create a release unless the manifest it assembled
# covers exactly these rows: a release is all of Beans' supported hosts or it is
# not a release. Adding a target here without adding the job that builds it will
# fail the publish job, which is the intent — this file is the contract.
# full: bundles a native C toolchain, so `beansc build` needs nothing else.
# slim: check/run/llvm/--emit ir need nothing; a native build needs Clang.
